hero.title: Start knowing nothing, leave ready for the table.
hero.lead: Learn the cards, the hands and the betting rounds step by step. Then play against virtual opponents while a coach explains why each decision was right or wrong.
hero.note: Free · No sign-up · No real money

what.title: What is poker?
what.lead: Poker is a game of cards, math and a bit of nerve. Let's start with three simple ideas.

panels.title: The goal
panels.text: Make the best hand at the end, or bet so that everyone else gives up (folds). Either way, the pot in the middle is yours.

panels.title: The cards
panels.text: A standard 52-card deck: 4 suits (spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs), 13 cards each from 2 to Ace. The best 5-card hand wins.

panels.title: Chips and the pot
panels.text: Chips stand in for money. All the chips players put in the middle are called the pot. It grows with every betting round.

ranks.title: 10 hands, weakest to strongest
ranks.lead: Everything in poker rests on this order. Hands get stronger as you move right.
ranks.leadList: Everything in poker rests on this order. Hands get stronger as you move down the list, with the strongest at the end.

steps.title: Basics
steps.text: Cards, hand rankings, blinds and betting rounds. Short chapters with mini quizzes.

steps.title: Variants
steps.text: Texas Hold'em, Omaha, Seven Card Stud and more: differences, rules and tips.

steps.title: Play
steps.text: Play at a real table against bots. The coach is with you on every decision and sums up each hand.

variants.title: Not one game, a family of games
variants.lead: They all use the same hand rankings (or their reverse), but dealing and betting structure change.

holdem.name: Texas Hold'em
holdem.desc: 2 hidden cards + 5 shared cards. The world's most popular poker.

omaha.name: Omaha
omaha.desc: 4 hidden cards, you must use exactly 2. Bigger hands.

sevenCardStud.name: Seven Card Stud
sevenCardStud.desc: No shared cards; some of yours are dealt face up. Classic and patient.

fiveCardDraw.name: Five Card Draw
fiveCardDraw.desc: Get 5 cards, swap the ones you don't want. The simplest poker.

razz.name: Razz
razz.desc: Stud in reverse: the lowest hand wins. A-2-3-4-5 is the best.

shortDeck.name: Short Deck
shortDeck.desc: A 36-card deck with 2s through 5s removed. Flush beats full house.

final.title: Your first hand is one click away.
final.lead: Learn the basics in 15 minutes, then play a hand right away.
